name: Turing Horns
desc: An anisotropic Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field driven into the labyrinth regime, its directional-diffusion tensor rotating continuously so warm coral-bone ridges perpetually reorganize between fingerprint, brain-coral and branching horn morphologies; renders as coral-horn, ink fingerprint on cream, ironbow thermal, pink-grey brain-coral, or teal bio-membrane.

scale.doc: display zoom (crop sub-rect, higher = magnified ridges)

aniso.doc: anisotropy strength — 0 isotropic maze, 1 strongly directional ridged horns

feed.doc: Gray-Scott feed rate base (regime; drifts on section)

kill.doc: Gray-Scott kill rate base (regime; drifts on section)

hue.doc: palette tint hue (warm coral at default)

style.doc: field->color philosophy: coral-horn = warm coral/bone ridges w/ rim-lit horns / fingerprint = dark ink ridges on cream paper (mono, abstract) / thermal = ironbow blackbody heat ramp / brain-coral = pink-grey convoluted cortex / bio = teal bioluminescent membranes on dark
